other.tags: Psychedelic rock with heavy blues and world music influences. The track features a prominent electric sitar or a guitar with a sitar-emulation effect, characterized by a sharp, metallic attack and sympathetic string resonance. A distorted electric guitar performs wide, slow vibrato bends and feedback-driven sustain. The drum kit uses a dry, 1970s-style production with a prominent tambourine on the backbeat. A fuzzy, overdriven bass guitar follows a repetitive, hypnotic riff. The arrangement includes a wah-wah pedal on the guitar and occasional reverse-tape effects. The tempo is 115 BPM in 4/4 time, likely in the key of E minor.

bass.tags: Industrial techno with heavy EBM influences. A distorted, resonant kick drum provides a constant four-on-the-floor pulse at 135 BPM in the key of D minor. A metallic, percussive synth sequence runs in sixteenth notes with automated low-pass filter sweeps. Gritty, overdriven bass stabs syncopate against the kick. High-frequency white noise bursts and mechanical clangs function as rhythmic accents. A dark, cinematic drone pad enters in the mid-section, processed with heavy reverb and bit-crushing. The arrangement features sudden structural drops and high-resonance filter resonance peaks. No melodic elements are present beyond the dissonant synth textures.

vocals.tags: Experimental electronic and ambient track featuring heavily processed vocal textures and cinematic sound design. The piece opens with a low-frequency drone and granular synthesis, transitioning into a rhythmic section characterized by a distorted, industrial-leaning synth bass and a syncopated electronic drum pattern. A recurring vocal motif, manipulated with pitch-shifting and extreme reverb, creates a haunting melodic layer. The arrangement utilizes high-pass filter sweeps and bit-crushing effects to create dynamic tension. The tempo is 110 BPM in the key of D minor. The percussion consists of a punchy, compressed kick and a metallic, gated snare that enters in the second half. Layers of atmospheric pads and resonant synth stabs provide harmonic density against the rhythmic elements.
